blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The House prosecution is wondering who will explain the financial records and disputed assets of Vice President Sara Duterte and her husband, lawyer Manases “Mans” Carpio, considering that the latter is not in the initial witness list of the defense. Rep. Gerville Luisto, the lead prosecutor, pointed this out on Sunday in an interview with Nimfa Ravelo and Isa Avendaño Umali over AM radio station DZBB’s “Bantay Balita sa Kongreso.” She said she was interested in hearing directly from Carpio about the defense’s contention that certain properties and financial information belonging to him should be treated separately from […]...
